new_how.instructions: Does the Spec Kit step `step` introduce a new decision about HOW the system is built, one not already settled by the approved artifacts in `files`?

criteria.true: The step makes a new design, architecture or implementation-approach decision.
criteria.false: The step only applies, refines or executes decisions already present in the artifacts.

per_item.instructions: Does the work in `files` for step `step` materially touch the review risk '{item}'?

criteria.true: The change affects '{item}' in a way a reviewer must check.
criteria.false: The change does not touch '{item}', or only mentions it without changing it.

route.instructions: Given the root-cause report in `files`, which delivery route fits the problem?

criteria.hotfix: Production is impacted now and the fix is a contained change with a rollback.
criteria.bugfix: The behavior deviates from a requirement already written in an existing spec.
criteria.feature: The problem is missing functionality that no existing spec promises.
criteria.module: The problem needs a new self-contained module or subsystem.

severity.instructions: How severe is the problem described in `files`?

criteria.critical: Data loss, security exposure or production down.
criteria.high: Main flow broken for many users, no workaround.

groups.instructions: Given the task list in `files`, how many parallel worker groups give the best speedup without workers colliding on the same files?

criteria.1: Tasks are mostly sequential or share most files.
criteria.2: Two clearly independent streams of work.
criteria.3: Three or more independent streams of moderate size.

per_item.instructions: Is the candidate decision question '{item}' in `context.candidates` material right now, meaning the answer changes what gets built given `files`?

criteria.true: The answer changes scope, architecture or acceptance and is not already settled.
criteria.false: Already answered by the artifacts, or its answer changes nothing material.

per_item.instructions: Is requirement {item} (its text is in `requirements`) fully implemented by the changed files in `files`?

criteria.true: The changed files implement every clause of {item}.
criteria.false: {item} is missing, partial or contradicted by the changed files.

transition.instructions: Given the decision question `context.dq` and the human answer `context.answer`, what happened to the question?

criteria.deferred: The answer postpones it to a later phase.
criteria.split: The answer shows it is really several separate decisions.
criteria.blocked: It cannot be decided until some evidence or dependency exists.
criteria.out-of-scope: The answer puts it outside this work item.

scope_delta.instructions: Did the answer `context.answer` change the scope of the work item described in `files`?

criteria.expanded: New work, behavior or deliverables were added.
criteria.reduced: Work, behavior or deliverables were removed.

progress.instructions: Did the answer `context.answer` resolve a decision or reduce an uncertainty of the work item?

criteria.true: At least one decision is settled or one open uncertainty is smaller.
criteria.false: Nothing was settled; the round only restated, deferred or went in circles.

repeat.instructions: Is `context.dq` the same decision as one already open in `context.frontier`, just worded differently?

criteria.true: Same underlying decision as an open question.

adr_needed.instructions: Is the decision in `context.answer` hard to reverse and a real trade-off between alternatives?

criteria.true: Costly to undo and alternatives were weighed.
criteria.false: Cheap to change or no real alternative.

per_item.instructions: Must the artifact '{item}' of the work item change because of `context.answer`?

criteria.true: '{item}' now states something false or misses the new decision.

criteria.constitution: A non-negotiable project rule every work item must obey.
criteria.agent-context: Operational guidance for agents working in this repository (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md).
criteria.adr-docs: A design decision or documentation of how something works.
criteria.memory: A fact useful across sessions but not a rule or doc.
criteria.discard: Not reusable, already known, or not supported by evidence.

duplicate.instructions: Is `context.candidate` already stated by a rule in `files`?

criteria.true: An existing rule in `files` already says the same thing.

bug_type.instructions: Given the bug report and spec in `files`, what kind of defect is it?

criteria.spec-gap: The spec never covered this behavior.
criteria.spec-conflict: The spec contradicts itself or another spec.
criteria.implementation-drift: The spec is right; the code does not follow it.
criteria.untested-flow: The behavior is specified and implemented but no test exercises this flow.
criteria.dependency-issue: A library, tool or external service misbehaves.

per_item.instructions: How severe is finding '{item}' described in `context.findings`?

criteria.critical: Breaks a constitution rule, loses data, opens a security hole or blocks the main flow.
criteria.high: Wrong behavior or missing requirement a user will hit.
criteria.medium: Inconsistency, ambiguity or gap with a workaround.

development_type.instructions: Which development type best fits the delivery unit in `files`?

criteria.frontend: The unit is mainly frontend work.
criteria.backend: The unit is mainly backend work.
criteria.mobile: The unit is mainly mobile work.
criteria.integration: The unit is mainly integration work.
criteria.data: The unit is mainly data work.
criteria.ml-ai: The unit is mainly ml-ai work.
criteria.infra-iac: The unit is mainly infra-iac work.
criteria.platform-devops: The unit is mainly platform-devops work.
criteria.security: The unit is mainly security work.
criteria.observability-sre: The unit is mainly observability-sre work.
criteria.qa: The unit is mainly qa work.
criteria.documentation: The unit is mainly documentation work.

module_kind.instructions: What kind of module is the delivery unit in `files`?

criteria.domain: Business capability owned by one domain.
criteria.platform: Shared infrastructure other modules build on.
criteria.cross-cutting: Concern spread across many modules (auth, logging, i18n).

per_item.instructions: Who must decide the decision '{item}' described in `context.decisions`?

criteria.human: It changes scope, public behavior or material risk.
criteria.author: A reversible implementation choice inside approved scope.
criteria.settled: Already decided by the artifacts in `files`.

per_item.instructions: Is the change to `{item}` in `files` unrelated to the feature described in `context.feature`, or generated noise?

criteria.true: The change does not serve the feature, or is generated/incidental.

per_item.instructions: Does the work item in `files` comply with the constitution clause '{item}' (its text is in `clauses`)?

criteria.PASS: The work item follows the clause.
criteria.NOT-APPLICABLE: The clause does not concern this work item.
criteria.VIOLATION: The work item breaks the clause.
